summary: Hello Group Inc. filed a Form 6-K containing its unaudited financial results for Q2 and first half of 2026. The release reports net revenues of RMB2,486.0 million (US$366.4 million) for Q2, down 5.1% year-over-year, with overseas revenues up 52%. Net income attributable to shareholders was RMB237.4 million (US$35.0 million), versus a net loss of RMB140.2 million in the prior-year period. Non-GAAP diluted earnings per ADS were RMB1.75 (US$0.26) for Q2. No special-situation corporate actions, transactions, or strategic events are disclosed. The filing is a routine earnings announcement with no M&A, tenders, spin-offs, or other special-situations components.
